description: Aethos Labs Blog — Bilingual engineering blog with Astro + MDX, documenting ARIA progress and tech essays

userStories.title: Initialize Astro project with Tailwind and MDX
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Astro project scaffolded with all required dependencies so that the blog can be built on top of it.
acceptanceCriteria: Astro project created at /home/hidekina/projetos/aethos-ideas/aethos-blog/
`@astrojs/tailwind`, `@astrojs/mdx`, `@astrojs/rss`, `@astrojs/sitemap` integrations installed
`shiki` installed for syntax highlighting
`reading-time` package installed
`astro.config.mjs` configured with all integrations
`bun dev` starts successfully on localhost:4321
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use `bun create astro@latest` with minimal template, then add integrations manually

userStories.title: Configure content collection for blog posts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a typed content collection schema so that all blog posts are validated at build time.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/content/config.ts` with Zod schema for blog collection
Schema fields: title (string), description (string), date (date), lang ('en' | 'pt'), tags (string[]), series (optional string), draft (optional boolean, default false)
Create `src/content/blog/` directory
Add two sample posts: one in EN (`2026-02-20-hello-world.mdx`) and one in PT (`2026-02-20-ola-mundo.mdx`)
Both sample posts have all required frontmatter fields
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create base layout with dark mode and design tokens
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the blog to have a clean dark-first design with purple Aethos accents so that it reflects the Aethos brand.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro` with HTML shell, meta tags, and slot
Tailwind config has custom colors: `primary: '#8b5cf6'` (purple), `background: '#0a0a0a'`, `surface: '#111111'`, `muted: '#1a1a1a'`
Default background is dark (`#0a0a0a`), text is `#e5e5e5`
Monospace font applied to `<code>` and `<pre>` elements (JetBrains Mono or system-mono fallback via Tailwind)
Dark mode toggle button in header: clicking toggles `dark` class on `<html>` and persists to localStorage
Site header includes: Aethos Labs logo/name (text), nav links (Home, About), dark mode toggle
Site footer includes: 'Aethos Labs' + current year
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Default must be dark. Toggle stores preference in localStorage key 'theme'.

userStories.title: Build post page with MDX rendering and syntax highlighting
userStories.description: As a reader, I want to view a blog post with nicely rendered content and highlighted code blocks so that I can enjoy reading technical posts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/pages/blog/[...slug].astro` that renders individual posts
Uses `BaseLayout.astro` and passes post title/description as meta tags
Post header shows: title, date (formatted as 'Feb 20, 2026'), language badge (EN/PT), reading time in minutes, tags as chips
MDX content renders with proper typography (prose styles via Tailwind typography plugin or custom CSS)
Code blocks use Shiki with `github-dark` theme
Series badge shown if `series` frontmatter is set (e.g., 'Part of: aria-progress')
Draft posts are not accessible (return 404 or redirect)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Build home page with post list
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see a list of all published posts on the home page so that I can browse what's available.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/pages/index.astro` as home page
Uses `BaseLayout.astro`
Hero section: 'Aethos Labs' heading, one-line description ('Engineering blog. AI experiments. Micro SaaS learnings.')
Post list shows: title (link to post), date, lang badge, tags, reading time, and description excerpt
Posts sorted by date descending (newest first)
Draft posts excluded from list
Empty state shown if no posts
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add tag and language filtering to home page
userStories.description: As a reader, I want to filter posts by tag or language so that I can find content relevant to me.
acceptanceCriteria: Language filter buttons at top of post list: 'All', 'EN', 'PT'
Tag filter chips below language filter: shows all unique tags from all posts
Filtering is client-side (no page reload) via vanilla JS or Astro's view transitions
Active filter is visually highlighted (purple border/background)
Tag and lang filters can be combined (AND logic)
URL updates with `?lang=en&tag=aria` query params so filters are shareable
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Keep filter logic in a small <script> block, no framework needed

userStories.title: Create About page
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to learn about Aethos Labs and ARIA so that I understand who is behind the blog.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/pages/about.astro`
Uses `BaseLayout.astro`
Section 1: 'Aethos Labs' — brief description of the micro SaaS factory philosophy
Section 2: 'ARIA' — introduce ARIA as an AI executive assistant being built in public
Section 3: 'César' — author bio (1 paragraph, can be placeholder)
Link to home page and GitHub (placeholder link ok)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add RSS feed
userStories.description: As a reader, I want to subscribe to the blog via RSS so that I get notified of new posts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/pages/rss.xml.ts` using `@astrojs/rss`
Feed includes all published posts (not drafts)
Each item has: title, description, pubDate, link
Feed title: 'Aethos Labs Blog'
RSS link tag added to `<head>` in BaseLayout
Accessing `/rss.xml` returns valid XML with correct content-type
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add series navigation to post page
userStories.description: As a reader following a post series, I want to navigate between parts easily so that I can read them in order.
acceptanceCriteria: At bottom of post page, if `series` frontmatter is set, show series navigation block
Series block shows: series name, list of all posts in the series with current post highlighted
Prev / Next buttons for adjacent posts in series (by date order)
If only one post in series, no prev/next shown but series name is displayed
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add dynamic OG image generation per post
userStories.description: As a content creator, I want each post to have a custom OG image so that social shares look professional.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/pages/og/[slug].png.ts` endpoint that generates OG images
Use `@vercel/og` or `satori` + `resvg-js` for image generation
OG image layout: dark background (#0a0a0a), purple accent border, post title (large), 'Aethos Labs' logo text, post date and tags
Each post's `<head>` has `<meta property='og:image'>` pointing to `/og/[slug].png`
Default OG image for home and about pages
Image dimensions: 1200x630
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use satori + resvg-js for Astro SSR compatibility. Install: `bun add satori @resvg/resvg-js`
